description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed the Secretary to the Prime Minister Secretary to the Cabinet of Ministers. Secretaries to the Ministries w.e.f. 24th September 2024.
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel appointments (Mr. G. P. Saputhanthri as Secretary to the Prime Minister, Mr. W. M. D. J. Fernando as Secretary to the Cabinet of Ministers, and 14 other individuals as Secretaries to various Ministries). It names specific individuals with their basic titles/positions but does not include detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or ministerial functions. The content focuses exclusively on who is being appointed to which position without elaborating on what those positions entail, making it a People Gazette.
